classes.a: data kept as the source of truth (EDN, WGSL, WIT, URDF, YAML, fixtures, assets)
classes.b: pure logic to port to .kotoba (used only as a port target of an o file)
classes.c: host or browser glue: Amu browser Wasm plus kotoba-client-runtime
classes.d: remove from CI and execution paths (kbb/nbb manifests and runners, Rust-era scripts, built output)
classes.o: CLJK source kept as the reference oracle; `port` says where its .kotoba twin goes
classes.keep: documentation, licences, provenance records, bot profiles and repository metadata, unchanged by the migration
classes.native: already native: .kotoba sources and the Amu gate runner and CI definition

multi-module.refusal: E6002 required module ... is missing from the explicit source paths
multi-module.what: a source that requires another namespace; the CLI compiles one self-contained file

keyword-map-literal.what: a keyword map literal such as {:a 1}; defrecord is admitted

f64-generic-arith.refusal: E2104 type mismatch in '*': expected :i64; E2101 for f64->i64
f64-generic-arith.what: + - * / < > on f64 values and f64 -> i64 conversion; the named f64-add / f64-mul / f64-lt / f64-sqrt are admitted

dispatch-forms.what: defmulti, defmethod, defprotocol, extend-protocol, extend-type, reify

destructuring.what: sequential or map destructuring in let / fn / loop bindings

atom-escape.refusal: E2140 atom escapes its let scope (straight-line swap!/reset!/deref only)
atom-escape.what: an atom stored, returned, defined at top level or mutated inside a loop or closure

host-interop.refusal: E6010 named operation js/... is not a registered capability; E2003 for an import declaration
host-interop.what: js/ globals, (.method obj), (.-field obj), #js literals and other host calls (platform math such as Math/sin counts as f64, not here)

placement.status: proposed 2026-10-31; entries apply the rule and stand unless the owner overrides them; kami-creative-studio decided by the owner 2026-10-31
